# Market Economy

<!-- STEP id="market" -->
No official set the new price. Buyers and sellers did, through **demand and supply**. Demand is how much buyers want to buy. Supply is how much sellers have to sell. Firms make what buyers want because they can earn a profit. In a **market economy**, individuals and private companies own most factories, shops and land. Demand and supply mostly decide what to produce, how to produce it, and how much.

<!-- STEP id="referee" -->
The government acts like a referee in a football match. A referee does not score goals, but makes sure everyone follows the rules. The government ensures safety and law and order. It does not control prices or production.

**In a market economy, demand and supply set prices, not the government.**
